My Garden Diary

Monday 31st August 2026 — lifted the last of the second early potatoes and cleared bed three.

Used sparingly where Glass Antiqua would be too decorative at very small sizes, as in the tiny capitals labelling each form field above.

The output documents

Two samples to check on your PC

You have two sample files — Sample-Table-August-2026.docx and Sample-Journal-August-2026.docx — filled with invented entries and made by the same document library the app will use. They carry the seasonal dressing in your palette: a Pale Sand page (August is a Summer month; the cornflower blue would drown print), gold page border, the month title with your motif beside it. Open both in LibreOffice Writer and check:

  1. Both open without warnings and you can type corrections anywhere.
  2. The table document is landscape: eight columns, one row per entry, dates dd.mm.yyyy.
  3. The journal is portrait: each day headed with its full date, photographs small with text wrapping round them.
  4. The seasonal dressing is there: page colour, gold border, month title and motif.
  5. Nothing breaks when you move or delete a photograph or add a paragraph.

The samples use LibreOffice's built-in Liberation fonts, guaranteed on your PC. If you'd like the documents to carry Glass Antiqua like the app, that needs the free font installed on your PC once — say so and I'll include plain instructions.

Nothing here is final. Name anything to change — a colour, a corner, a motif, a word — and I'll revise until it's right. Stage 2 begins only when you approve all three parts: the four screens, one icon, and both sample documents.
